RiskLevel.description: Risk classification for individual recovery steps.
RiskLevel.title: RiskLevel

description:
A single step in the recovery command sequence.

Each step maps to a spacecraft command, its rationale, timing,
verification criteria, and risk level.  The safety validator
may override the risk to BLOCKED.

rationale.description: Why this command is issued at this point in the sequence
rationale.title: Rationale

risk.description: Risk level of this step (LOW / MEDIUM / HIGH / BLOCKED)

verify.description: Condition to check after wait, e.g. 'GYRO_A_RATE returns valid'
verify.title: Verify

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait after issuing command before verifying
wait_seconds.title: Wait Seconds

title: RecoveryStep
